candidates.name: Jobicy Remote Jobs API
candidates.coverage: Worldwide remote roles with geo, category, type, date, and salary fields
candidates.terms: Attribution and canonical Jobicy link required; fair use; do not poll more than once per hour.
candidates.nextStep: Add a JSON adapter, map jobGeo to evidence-based remoteEligibility, and run a live fixture/schema test.

candidates.name: Remotive Remote Jobs API
candidates.coverage: Worldwide remote roles with public API and RSS access
candidates.terms: Link to the Remotive job URL and mention Remotive; public jobs are delayed 24 hours; no third-party submission or lead-capture wall.
candidates.nextStep: Add a JSON adapter and visible Remotive attribution; keep applications on the canonical source.

candidates.name: Remote OK public API
candidates.coverage: Worldwide, regional, and country-filtered remote roles, including Cameroon
candidates.terms: Follow links to the Remote OK URL and mention Remote OK as the source.
candidates.nextStep: Add a JSON adapter, parse location and country scope, and retain Remote OK attribution.

candidates.name: We Work Remotely global RSS

candidates.terms: Use the public RSS endpoint, retain canonical links and source attribution, and do not access account-only paths.
